desc:
QUALITY INGREDIENTS: Made with hearty whole grain oats; These bars contain no artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

WHOLE GRAIN: Wholesome snacks with 20g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

CRUNCHY GRANOLA BARS: Nature Valley Crunchy Peanut Butter Granola Bars combine delicious whole grain oats with creamy peanut butter for a delightful snack

PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Easy bars for an on the go treat the entire family will enjoy; Slip one into a backpack or lunch box for a wholesome bite any time

CONTAINS: One regular cardboard box of Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars, Peanut Butter, 12 Ct, 8.94 oz (6 pouches); Perfect for instant snacking
features:
Key Features:

Delicious Peanut Butter Flavor

Combines roasted peanut butter with crunchy whole grain oats for a satisfying snack.

Whole Grain Goodness

Made with 100% whole grain oats, offering a hearty texture and wholesome energy.

Crunchy Texture

Perfectly baked for that signature Nature Valley crunch in every bite.

Individually Wrapped Bars

Convenient twin-bar packs are great for on-the-go snacking, lunchboxes, or quick fuel between meals.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors

A more natural snack option without unnecessary additives.

Benefits:

Energy Boost

A solid source of complex carbs to keep you going during busy days, hikes, or workouts.

Fiber-Rich

Supports digestion with a good dose of dietary fiber.

Portable & Convenient

Easy to stash in a backpack, purse, or car—ideal for travel and outdoor adventures.

Kid-Approved

Tasty enough to satisfy picky eaters while still being made with real ingredients.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Peanut Butter (peanuts, salt), Rice Flour, Brown Sugar Syrup, Salt, Baking Soda, Soy Lecithin.
